headline: 11 mainnet contracts catalogued on ZIGChain (CosmWasm/Bech32 addresses); on-chain read API unavailable (ZIGChain not an EVM chain supported by DeFiPunkd).

findings.text: ZIGChain is a Cosmos-based chain; canonical block explorers are zigscan.org and staking-explorer.com/explorer/zigchain. Neither is an EVM explorer indexable via DeFiPunkd read API. No EVM address name-tag search possible. zigscan.org surfaced in search results as the primary ZIGChain explorer.

Canonical deployed-contracts page found at docs.valdora.finance/smart-contracts. Lists 5 vault contracts, 1 staker contract, 1 token contract, and 4 ledger contracts on mainnet ZIGChain. All addresses use Cosmos Bech32 (zig1...) format, not EVM 0x format.

docs.valdora.finance/security names OAK Security as auditor. An X post from @SecurityOak (July 27, 2026) confirms a published audit report for 'Valdora ETH Vault smart contracts' hosted on Oak Security's GitHub at oak-security/audit-reports. The specific PDF URL from the t.co short link was not directly resolved in this run; the report title references 'ETH Vault' which may be a separate deployment from the ZIGChain liquid staking contracts. No separate liquid staking audit PDF URL was surfaced.

No GitHub repository is recorded in protocol.github. No GitHub org or repo was discovered from website or docs fetch. The OAK Security audit is hosted on github.com/oak-security/audit-reports but the Valdora protocol source repo remains unknown.

Protocol is single-chain (ZIGChain only per docs). No multi-chain enumeration required beyond ZIGChain. Testnet addresses also listed in docs but not catalogued as admin_addresses (testnet out of scope for control surface).
Staker Contract delegates to 4 Ledger Contracts (not a factory pattern). All 4 ledger addresses explicitly listed in docs. No factory enumeration needed; all children are pre-enumerated.

Role taxonomy applied: staker (owner/vault logic), token (stZIG CW20/tokenfactory token), vault (5 yield strategy vaults), ledger (4 validator-delegation contracts). actor_class set to 'unknown' for all because bytecode/owner reads are not feasible via DeFiPunkd (ZIGChain not supported).

All 11 addresses trace to docs.valdora.finance/smart-contracts (fetched this run). No snippet-only sightings. Addresses stored in admin_addresses with zig1... Bech32 notation; evidence[] address field omitted (format constraint requires 0x EVM addresses).

rationale.verdict: Walked protocol website, docs (smart-contracts, architecture, security, FAQs) and search results. Catalogued 11 mainnet ZIGChain contracts from the canonical deployments page. On-chain state reads are not possible via DeFiPunkd (ZIGChain is Cosmos-based, not in supported EVM chainIds). OAK Security performed an audit of the ETH Vault contracts (published July 2026); liquid staking CosmWasm audit status is referenced but no PDF URL resolved this run. Grade is unknown because on-chain verification of contract state, ownership, and upgrade authority could not be performed.

protocol_metadata.about: Valdora Finance is an institutional-grade liquid staking and vault protocol on ZIGChain. Users stake ZIG tokens through the Staker Contract to receive stZIG, a liquid receipt token that auto-compounds staking rewards via its exchange rate; stZIG can be used across supported ZIGChain DeFi markets or redeemed for ZIG after a 21–23 day unbonding period. The protocol also offers curated yield vault strategies (stablecoin, quant, credit, and tokenized equity vaults) where users deposit USDC to earn structured returns. Staked ZIG is distributed across multiple Ledger Contracts that each delegate to ZIGChain validators, reducing single-point-of-failure risk.
